The reference permits use under the PSF license for Python 2.2 or GPLv2;

Python 3.14.2 html and urllib.parse compatibility behavior is covered by
the accompanying Python notices. BeautifulSoup 4.15.0 reference extraction
and generated entity data retain BEAUTIFULSOUP-LICENSE.txt.

html5gum 0.9.1 is used for tokenization, not browser DOM reconstruction.
Its license is retained in HTML5GUM-LICENSE.txt. Raw source spans allow
the legacy entity and newline conventions to be reproduced separately.

Reference source and frozen data are used only for implementation parity;
no external page, model, or research evaluation was used for selection.
